name: elide
description: Elide for Kotlin, Java and Android: project sync, build/run/debug, device-free Compose previews, deployment targets, Logcat and tests.
author: Elide Technologies, Inc.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Syncing a project runs the workspace's Elide CLI (`elide project export`, `elide install`, `elide classpath`), so an untrusted workspace could execute arbitrary code.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The Elide CLI, the JDK, and the generated `workspace.json` all need a real filesystem.

semanticTokenModifiers.description: A `@Composable` function, or a call of one.
A `var`: a variable or property that can be reassigned.

elide.home.markdownDescription: Elide distribution root (the directory containing `bin/elide`). Empty: use `$ELIDE_HOME`, the platform install locations, then `elide` on `PATH`.

elide.jdk.home.markdownDescription: JDK home used for symbol resolution in the Kotlin LSP. Empty: `jvm.javaHome` from the manifest, then `$JAVA_HOME`, then installed JDKs (SDKMAN, /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines, /usr/lib/jvm, Program Files) matching `jvm.target`.

elide.sync.onStartup.description: Sync Elide projects when the workspace opens.

elide.sync.onManifestChange.description: What to do when elide.pkl changes, or a local Pkl module it imports, amends or extends (such as a shared versions.pkl), or when the lockfile's resolved dependencies do. Rewrites of .dev/elide.lock*.bin that leave the dependencies unchanged (every elide run/test/build does one) are ignored.

elide.sync.showProgressNotification.markdownDescription: Show a notification with the step in progress, and a Cancel button, while a sync runs for more than a couple of seconds. The status bar and the **Elide › Activity** view show progress either way.

elide.kotlinLsp.writeWorkspaceJson.markdownDescription: Write `workspace.json` at the workspace folder root so the JetBrains Kotlin LSP imports the Elide project model. Folders on Komodo's language server (`#elide.kotlinLsp.server#` = `komodo`) never get one.

enumDescriptions: The JetBrains Kotlin LSP (`JetBrains.kotlin-server`, installed separately) imports the generated `workspace.json`.

Experimental: Komodo's native language server, installed on demand by Elide, analyzes Kotlin sources from the Elide project model. No workspace.json or JetBrains server is needed for the folder. One server serves every Komodo folder of the window.
elide.kotlinLsp.server.markdownDescription: Kotlin language server for the folder's Elide projects. `komodo` requires an Elide release supporting on-demand Komodo resolution. If missing, choose **Install Komodo** explicitly; activation and sync never download it. With `komodo`, `#elide.debug.adapter#` defaults to Komodo's debugger.

elide.kotlinLsp.komodo.path.markdownDescription: Absolute executable path to a developer-managed Komodo build. Leave empty to resolve through the selected Elide CLI's managed component store, not PATH or the Elide distribution. An invalid override is reported and never replaced. Applies to the whole window.

elide.kotlinLsp.komodo.pluginDirectory.markdownDescription: Developer override for Kotlin compiler plugin jars built for Komodo's compiler. Empty uses Elide's resolved plugin directory for a managed component, or the explicit developer bundle's own plugins.

elide.kotlinLsp.komodo.javaHome.markdownDescription: Developer override for the JDK home whose platform classes and modules Komodo resolves against (JAVA_HOME). Empty uses the JDK inputs returned by Elide's resolver. An explicit developer executable inherits JAVA_HOME instead.

elide.kotlinLsp.komodo.maxHeap.markdownDescription: Maximum heap of the native Komodo server (`-Xmx`), such as `768m` or `1g`. Empty: the native image's default.

enumDescriptions: Attach with the JetBrains Kotlin LSP's JVM debugger (`JetBrains.kotlin-server`).
Attach with Komodo's Kotlin debugger (`komodo --dap`), which maps the target JVM's classes to the folder's sources.
elide.debug.adapter.markdownDescription: Debug adapter used to attach to the JVM started by `elide run --debugger`. Unset: `komodo` for a folder on Komodo's language server (`#elide.kotlinLsp.server#`), `intellij` otherwise. `komodo` is served by the same executable as Komodo's language server and needs the folder on that server.

enumDescriptions: GDB when one is available, LLDB on macOS, which ships none.
Drive GDB, which is what Native Image emits DWARF for.
Drive LLDB through the `lldb-mi` the C/C++ extension bundles.
elide.debug.nativeMiMode.markdownDescription: Machine-interface debugger the C/C++ extension drives for an `elide-native` session on a Native Image binary.

elide.debug.miDebuggerPath.markdownDescription: `gdb` (or `lldb-mi`) binary used by `elide-native` sessions. Empty: resolve `gdb` on `PATH`, and leave LLDB to the copy the C/C++ extension bundles.

elide.install.classifiers.markdownDescription: Classifier jars installed for the manifest's declared Maven packages. `sources` lets Go to Definition open library code in the Kotlin LSP; `docs` adds javadoc jars; an empty list installs classes only. Elide's own Kotlin and JUnit jars are published without classifiers.

elide.android.sdk.markdownDescription: Android SDK root used to list attached devices. Empty resolves the SDK an Elide build would use: the manifest's `android.sdk`, then `ANDROID_HOME`, then `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT`, then the location the SDK installs itself in on this platform.

elide.android.emulatorWindow.markdownDescription: Boot the Android emulator with a window. Off passes `--no-window`, which runs it headless.

elide.android.composePreview.prewarm.markdownDescription: Start the Compose preview backend in the background when a Kotlin file with `@Preview` functions is focused in a trusted Android project, so **Elide: Open Compose Preview** opens in about a second. Runs the file's previews from the last build's classes; never builds, and never downloads the renderer runtime. Requires `#elide.android.composePreview.keepAliveMinutes#` above 0.

elide.android.composePreview.keepAliveMi.markdownDescription: Minutes an unused Compose preview backend (snapshot workers, or a renderer session in the Komodo language server) stays warm after its panel closes or after prewarming. `0` closes the renderer session with its panel and disables prewarming; Komodo's language server remains available.

enumDescriptions: Experimental: every card is live, rendered by the workspace's Komodo language server; a card it cannot render shows why.
elide.android.composePreview.engine.markdownDescription: Engine of the Compose preview. `layoutlib` (the default) renders design-time snapshots, with source navigation from **Inspect**. `komodo` (experimental) renders live cards inside the workspace's Komodo language server: unsaved Kotlin edits, clicks, keyboard input into a focused card, compile errors in Problems, and **Inspect** for composable calls by their measured bounds, with source navigation to their call sites. It requires `#elide.kotlinLsp.server#` = `komodo`, with a compatible component installed explicitly through Elide; there is no fallback to `layoutlib`. Takes effect when a preview panel opens.

elide.android.composePreview.mcp.enabled.markdownDescription: Serve the Compose preview to AI agents over MCP: a token-protected HTTP server on `127.0.0.1`, offered to VS Code's agents (chat agent mode) and to agents in the integrated terminal (`ELIDE_COMPOSE_PREVIEW_MCP_URL`, `ELIDE_COMPOSE_PREVIEW_MCP_TOKEN`); **Elide: Copy Compose Preview MCP Server Configuration** gives it to other clients. Agents render composables by code reference, `@Preview` or not, with the configured `#elide.android.composePreview.engine#`, and get each card's image and layout; with `komodo`, live sessions take taps and typing. Rendering runs the project's code: trusted workspaces only.

elide.flags.markdownDescription: `-f NAME[=VALUE]` build flags passed to every Elide invocation, project sync included; the manifest reads them as `build.flags`. Changing them marks the resolved project model stale.

elide.build.options.markdownDescription: Default options for `elide build`, keyed by option name: `{ "no-cache": true, "offline": true }` runs `elide build --no-cache --offline`. `true` emits the bare flag, `false` omits it, an array repeats the option, anything else becomes `--name=value`. Tasks and launch configurations override individual keys.

elide.run.options.markdownDescription: Default options for `elide run`, keyed by option name: `{ "coverage": true, "timeout": "30s" }` runs `elide run --coverage --timeout=30s`.

elide.test.options.markdownDescription: Default options for `elide test`, keyed by option name: `{ "bail": 3, "concurrency": 4 }` runs `elide test --bail=3 --concurrency=4`. Test Explorer runs use them too, except for `reporter`, which stays `tap` because the extension parses that stream.

elide.install.options.markdownDescription: Default options for `elide install`, keyed by option name. The `install` task fetches the classifiers `#elide.install.classifiers#` names, as project sync does; `slim` and `with` here override that.

elide.codeLens.enabled.description: Show Run/Debug code lenses above JVM main functions and on entrypoints, scripts and artifacts in elide.pkl.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No Elide project (`elide.pkl`) in this workspace.
[New Project…](command:elide.newProject)
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)
[Elide documentation](https://docs.elide.dev)

Nothing has run yet. Syncs and Compose preview builds appear here while they run, step by step, with the time each step took and its output.
[Sync Project(s)](command:elide.sync)

args.description: Positional arguments after the command: build targets, test paths, or the entrypoint `elide run` runs.

flags.markdownDescription: `-f NAME[=VALUE]` build flags, added to those in `elide.flags`.

options.markdownDescription: CLI options for the command: `{ "no-cache": true, "bail": 3 }` becomes `--no-cache --bail=3`. `true` emits the bare flag, `false` omits it (cancelling a default from `elide.<command>.options`), an array repeats the option.

programArgs.markdownDescription: Arguments passed after `--`: the application's own arguments for `run`, subprocess passthrough for `build` and `test`.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the Elide process.

project.description: Project root relative to the workspace folder; in an Elide workspace, the member's directory.

command.markdownDescription: Elide command to debug: `run` (the default), `test`, or `build` for one or more build targets.

entrypoint.markdownDescription: File, manifest script or entrypoint name `elide run` runs; empty lets Elide resolve `entrypoint`/`jvm.main`. Not used by `build`, which takes `targets`.

targets.markdownDescription: Build targets to debug, for `command: "build"`: `run`, `jvm-test`, … — `elide build --inspect` lists them.

args.description: Arguments passed to the debugged program after `--`.

elideArgs.description: Further positional arguments of the Elide command itself: test paths, for instance.

flags.markdownDescription: `-f NAME[=VALUE]` build flags, added to those in `elide.flags`.

options.markdownDescription: CLI options for the command: `{ "test-name-pattern": "MyTest", "no-cache": true }` becomes `--test-name-pattern=MyTest --no-cache`. `--debugger` is always added; set `debugger` here to choose its value.

project.description: Project root relative to the workspace folder; in an Elide workspace, the member's directory.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the Elide process.

configurationSnippets.label: Elide: Run (debug)
configurationSnippets.description: Run the project's entrypoint with `elide run --debugger` and attach.

configurationSnippets.label: Elide: Build target (debug)
configurationSnippets.description: Run build targets with `elide build <targets> --debugger` and attach.

artifact.markdownDescription: Native Image artifact to build and debug: the key of its entry in the `artifacts` block of `elide.pkl`, which is also the build target `elide build` takes.

program.markdownDescription: Binary to debug, when it is not the one the artifact's build writes to `.dev/artifacts/native-image/`. A relative path resolves against the project root.

build.markdownDescription: Build `artifact` before debugging it. `false` debugs whatever the last build left behind.

args.description: Arguments passed to the debugged program.

cwd.description: Working directory of the debugged program; defaults to the project root.

stopAtEntry.description: Break on the image's entry point instead of running to the first breakpoint.

project.description: Project root relative to the workspace folder; in an Elide workspace, the member's directory.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the debugged program.

configurationSnippets.label: Elide: Native Image (debug)
configurationSnippets.description: Build a Native Image artifact and debug the binary it produced with GDB.

artifact.markdownDescription: Android application package to build, install and debug: the key of its entry in the `artifacts` block of `elide.pkl`.

device.markdownDescription: Device serial to pin the debug launch to (`--device=<serial>`). Empty uses the remembered deployment target or offers a device selection; a disconnected selection never silently deploys elsewhere.

options.markdownDescription: CLI build options layered over `elide.build.options`. Use `device`, not an option, to select the deployment device.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the Elide build process.

port.markdownDescription: Local port of a JDWP socket already forwarded off a device: attach to it, building and installing nothing.

project.description: Project root relative to the workspace folder; in an Elide workspace, the member's directory.

configurationSnippets.label: Elide: Android app (debug)
configurationSnippets.description: Build an APK, install and launch it waiting for a debugger, and attach over JDWP.

hostName.description: Host of the JDWP agent to attach to.

port.description: Port of the JDWP agent to attach to.

timeout.description: Milliseconds to keep retrying the connection.

sourceRoots.markdownDescription: Further source directories to resolve the JVM's source paths (`pkg/File.kt`) against, besides the module source roots of the Komodo project manifest.

mainClass.description: Fully qualified main class (for a top-level Kotlin `main`, `pkg.FileKt`).

classPaths.description: Class path entries of the program.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the program.

javaHome.description: JDK to run the program on; defaults to the one the debugger runs on.

configurationSnippets.label: Komodo Kotlin: Attach
configurationSnippets.description: Attach Komodo's Kotlin debugger to a JVM listening for JDWP.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Elide
walkthroughs.description: Build, run, test and debug Kotlin/JVM and Android projects with the Elide build tool.

steps.title: Install Elide
steps.description:
The extension drives the `elide` CLI, so Elide 1.5+ must be installed.
[Installation docs](https://docs.elide.dev/installation)
[Set elide.home](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22elide.home%22)

steps.title: Open or create a project
steps.description:
A project is a folder with an `elide.pkl` manifest.
[New Project…](command:elide.newProject)
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)

steps.title: Grow into a workspace
steps.description:
A root manifest listing `workspace.members` builds several projects as one graph.
[Add Workspace Member…](command:elide.addMember)

steps.title: Sync with the Kotlin language server
steps.description:
Syncing hands the project model to the Kotlin language server so it resolves your sources and dependencies.
[Sync now](command:elide.sync)

steps.title: Prepare Android development
steps.description:
Check your SDK and devices even before sync succeeds. Then choose a persistent APK and device for Run and Debug.
[Check Android Environment](command:elide.androidDoctor)
[Select Android Deployment Target…](command:elide.androidSelectTarget)
[Open Compose Preview](command:elide.androidComposePreview)

steps.title: Run and debug
steps.description:
Code lenses run or debug a `main` function and the targets of `elide.pkl`.
[Run Elide Command…](command:elide.runTask)

steps.title: Run tests
steps.description:
JUnit tests appear in the Testing view and run through `elide test`.
[Open Testing](command:workbench.view.testing.focus)
